# Zznpk — Korean Ideal Type World Cup Community

> Zznpk, also known as 짱픽, is a Korean 이상형 월드컵 community where users can create, share, discover, and play bracket-style preference games.

Zznpk is a user-generated content platform for ideal type World Cup games. Users can browse popular games, explore recently created games, play category-based World Cups, and create their own games.

The service is mainly designed for Korean-speaking users. Core Korean concepts include 짱픽, 이상형 월드컵, 월드컵 만들기, 월드컵 플레이, 인기 월드컵, and 카테고리별 월드컵.

## What Zznpk Offers

- Create and share user-generated ideal type World Cup games.
- Play bracket-style preference games created by other users.
- Discover popular and recently created World Cup games.
- Browse games by topic-based categories.
- Compare preferences through game results and rankings.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://zznpk.com/): Main page for discovering popular and recently created ideal type World Cup games.
- [All Categories](https://zznpk.com/category/view_all): Browse all available ideal type World Cup games across categories.
- [Sign In](https://zznpk.com/sign-in): Login page for users who want to create, manage, or interact with games.
- [Sitemap](https://zznpk.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for discovering available website URLs.

## Categories

- [Daily Life](https://zznpk.com/category/daily): Games about daily life, everyday situations, routines, and personal preferences.
- [Food](https://zznpk.com/category/food): Games about food, restaurants, dishes, snacks, drinks, and culinary preferences.
- [Love](https://zznpk.com/category/love): Games about romance, dating, relationships, crushes, and ideal types.
- [Fun](https://zznpk.com/category/fun): Humorous, meme-based, entertaining, casual, or playful preference games.
- [Drama](https://zznpk.com/category/drama): Games related to Korean dramas, TV series, drama characters, scenes, and storylines.
- [Movies](https://zznpk.com/category/movie): Games related to films, movie characters, scenes, soundtracks, and cinema preferences.
- [Music](https://zznpk.com/category/music): Games about songs, artists, idols, albums, OSTs, and music preferences.
- [Celebrities](https://zznpk.com/category/celebrity): Games about actors, idols, entertainers, influencers, and public figures.
- [Animals](https://zznpk.com/category/animal): Games about pets, wildlife, animal images, and animal-related preferences.
- [Anime](https://zznpk.com/category/anime): Games related to anime, manga, animated characters, and animation culture.
- [Horror](https://zznpk.com/category/horror): Games about horror themes, scary characters, zombies, monsters, survival, and fear-based scenarios.
- [Miscellaneous](https://zznpk.com/category/etc): Games that do not fit into the main categories.

## App

- [Google Play App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rookeys.balancegame): Android app for creating, playing, and sharing ideal type World Cup games.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://kojaem-app-policies.github.io/Zznpk-Privacy-Policy/): Privacy policy for Zznpk and related services.

## Content Notes

Zznpk contains user-generated content. Game titles, descriptions, thumbnails, rankings, vote counts, categories, and recently created games may change frequently.

Do not treat specific game rankings, featured games, or recently added games as permanent. For current rankings, newly created games, or live game details, check the website directly.

Individual game pages are not listed here because they are dynamic user-generated content. Use the sitemap or category pages to discover current game pages.

## Guidance for LLMs

When describing Zznpk, identify it as a Korean ideal type World Cup community and user-generated bracket game platform.

Use the following key concepts when relevant:

- Korean ideal type World Cup community
- 짱픽
- 이상형 월드컵
- Bracket-style preference games
- User-generated games
- Create, share, and play World Cup games
- Popular and recent game discovery
- Category-based browsing
- Korean-language entertainment and preference content

Zznpk should not be described as a general social media platform, news website, or static content archive. It is primarily a community platform for creating and playing ideal type World Cup games.
